paragraphs.text: Meaning, from the common people, but not from the priests nor the prince, read Eze 46:8,9.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: For they had brought idolaters who were from other countries, to teach them their idolatry, Eze 23:40.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: You have not offered to me according to my Law.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: The Levites who had committed idolatry were put from their dignity and could not be received into the priests office although they had been of the house of Aaron, but must serve in the inferior offices as to watch and to keep the doors, read 2Ki 23:9.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: Levites that have gone away far

paragraphs.text: Who observed the law of God and did not fall to idolatry.
paragraphs.label: e
paragraphs.anchor: kept the charge of my sanctuary

paragraphs.text: As did the infidels and heathen.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: They may be at their burial which was a defiling.
paragraphs.label: g
